newsitem.title: USA: Collaborative does not see Q3, Q4 profit.
newsitem.headline: Collaborative does not see Q3, Q4 profit.

text.p: Collaborative Clinical Research Inc said Thursday it does not expect to make a profit in the third and fourth quarters and has hired a financial adviser.

"Based on current business levels, we do not anticipate that Collaborative will report a profit in either the third or the fourth quarters of 1997," said Chief Executive Jeffrey Green. "In addition to the steps we are taking to address our backlog and performance issues, we have retained a financial adviser to assist us with our merger and acquisition activities and with strategic joint venture alliances intended to further build our full-service capabilities."
Green said the company's second quarter revenue decline reflects the fact that Collaborative's backlog remains below goal.
Collaborative today reported second quarter revenues of $4.5 million and a net loss of $486,000, down from revenues of $6.8 million and net income of $288,000 for the second quarter of 1996.
